title: 第9656章 冉姐姐谢谢你呢第9655章 红月的主宰
content_zh:
这一路上，叶无缺看起来似乎是安安静静的跟在冉少燕后面，但属于他的感知早已扩散出去，无处不在。
不过，并未感应到哪里不对劲，反而见识到了这第十域的繁华与古老。
那些汇集在星空中的古建筑当真是巧夺天工，好似仙界仙宫一般，美轮美奂。
房间前。
冉少燕看到了屋内的小型传送阵不断闪耀着光辉，美眸中也是闪过了一丝满意。
“叶阁下，这里算是一个临时传送点，也是我们冉家安排的准备之一。”
“经由这个小型传送阵，我们可以直接抵达第十域的‘春岚城’，那里，距离我冉家的隐秘驻地就很接近了。”
冉少燕笑着为叶无缺介绍道，当然目光也同时看向了灵墨轩与王明阳。
灵墨轩沧桑的眸子内闪过一丝感慨。
“灵爷爷，由此可见，这冉少燕姐姐所代表的冉家，应该是阵营对外的掩饰身份之一。”
“各种准备很充分，果然是经营多年。”
灵墨轩立刻同样传音回答道:“阵营的小心与谨慎自然早有耳闻，这就是势力机构彻底运转起来后所带来的益处之一。”
“只不过明阳你真没感觉的出来这冉少燕看起来……有些生疏吗?”
“虽然她身份应该不会有任何问题，可各方面的手段有时候会感觉的出来有些稚嫩。”
“灵爷爷你这么一说，的确有点，她身份肯定不简单，难不成之前从来没有出行动过?”
就在灵墨轩与王明阳在交流时，冉少燕率先走进了屋子内。
跟在后面的叶无缺目光微动。
这样的手段和无处不在的安排，进一步证明了他们口中那“阵营”的不简单，看起来不是小打小闹，而是经营了很多很多年。
嗡嗡嗡!
随着众人踏入小型传送阵后，冉少燕立刻以特殊的手法激活，传送阵马上亮起，空间之力闪耀瞬间笼罩了众人。

当空间光辉重新散去后，小型传送阵内已经失去了众人的身影，这里重新变得安静。
……
第十域。
春岚城。
这是位于第十域相对偏西边方向的一座巨城，坐落在名为‘天谷宇宙’内，也是这里的城池之一，人气不错，有很多生灵会聚集。
因为春岚城这里盛产几样整个中央帝域都颇有名气的天材地宝与原材料。
嗡!
此时，距离春岚城约莫十数里之外的一片丛林内的某一处，突然亮起了一道空间之力的光辉。
空间之力闪耀，驱散了这里的尘埃与落叶，数道身影凭空出现，正是冉少燕以及叶无缺等人。
“叶阁下，灵老，王明阳，前面那就是春岚城!”
飞快走出丛林后，冉少燕指向了前方虚空。
入目所及，可以看到一座恢宏又精美的古老城池坐落在那里，城池的周遭爬满了花瓣的藤蔓，看起来百花盛开在城墙上，给人一种春意盎然，生机勃勃的姿态。
各种各样的生灵进出那春岚城，好似踏青郊游一般。
“我冉家的隐秘驻点之一，就在春岚城不远的副城内……”
冉少燕继续引路，踏进春岚城后，这里的风土人情与各种各样的特色举不胜数，颇为的奇妙。
而叶无缺可以感知到，进出春岚城的不同种族生灵中，神灵很多。
羽神都有大量，但达到昊神层次的，就少了很多很多，至于玄神级别的，似乎更加的少，但并非没有。
春岚城一共有三座副城，几乎比邻春岚城，乍一看连成一体的。
其中第二座副城，论气氛立刻就安静了很多，但人流量还是不少。
在冉少燕的带领下，七拐八拐，很快就来到了相对隐蔽的一处角落。
content_en:
Along the way, Ye Wuque seemed to be following Ran Shaoyan quietly, but his perception had already spread out and was everywhere.
However, he didn't sense anything was wrong. Instead, he saw the prosperity and antiquity of this tenth domain.
Those ancient buildings gathered in the starry sky are really ingenious, just like a fairy palace in the fairyland, and they are magnificent.
in front of the room.
Ran Shaoyan saw the small teleportation array in the room shining continuously, and a trace of satisfaction flashed in her beautiful eyes.
"Your Excellency Ye, this is a temporary teleportation point, and it is also one of the preparations arranged by our Ran family."
"Through this small teleportation array, we can directly reach the 'Chunlan City' in the tenth domain, which is very close to the secret residence of my Ran family."
Ran Shaoyan introduced Ye Wuque with a smile, and of course looked at Lingmo Xuan and Wang Mingyang at the same time.
A trace of emotion flashed in Lingmoxuan's vicissitudes of life.
"Grandpa Ling, it can be seen from this that the Ran family represented by sister Ran Shaoyan should be one of the camp's hidden identities to the outside world."
"Every preparation is very complete. It has been in business for many years."
Lingmoxuan immediately responded via the same message: "Of course we have heard of the caution and prudence of the camp for a long time. This is one of the benefits brought by the complete operation of the power organization."
"It's just that Mingyang, you really can't tell that Ran Shaoyan looks... a little unfamiliar?"
"Although there shouldn't be any problems with her identity, her methods sometimes feel a bit immature."
"Grandpa Ling, what you said is true. Her identity is definitely not simple. Is it possible that she has never taken action before?"
While Lingmo Xuan and Wang Mingyang were communicating, Ran Shaoyan walked into the room first.
Ye Wuque, who was following behind, moved his eyes slightly.
Such methods and ubiquitous arrangements further prove that the "camp" they talk about is not simple. It seems that it is not a small matter, but has been operating for many, many years.
Buzz buzz!
As everyone stepped into the small teleportation array, Ran Shaoyan immediately activated it with a special technique. The teleportation array immediately lit up, and the power of space shone and enveloped everyone in an instant.
When the light in the space dispersed again, no one was around in the small teleportation array, and the place became quiet again.
…
The tenth domain.
Chunlan City.
This is a huge city located relatively west of the Tenth Domain. It is located in the "Tiangu Universe" and is also one of the cities here. It is very popular and many creatures gather there.
Because Chunlan City is rich in several treasures and raw materials that are famous throughout the Central Imperial Territory.
Buzz!
At this time, somewhere in a jungle about ten miles away from Chunlan City, a ray of space power suddenly lit up.
The power of space shone, dispersing the dust and fallen leaves here, and several figures appeared out of thin air, none other than Ran Shaoyan, Ye Wuque and others.
"Your Excellency Ye, Mr. Ling, Wang Mingyang, that's Chunlan City in front of you!"
After quickly walking out of the jungle, Ran Shaoyan pointed to the void ahead.
As far as the eye can see, you can see a magnificent and exquisite ancient city located there. The surroundings of the city are covered with vines with petals. It seems that flowers are blooming on the city wall, giving people a springy and vibrant appearance.
All kinds of creatures come in and out of Chunlan City, just like going on an outing.
"One of the secret locations of my Ran family is in the sub-city not far from Chunlan City..."
Ran Shaoyan continued to lead the way, and after stepping into Chunlan City, the local customs, customs and various features here were countless, which was quite wonderful.
And Ye Wuque could sense that among the creatures of different races entering and leaving Chunlan City, there were many gods.
There are a lot of Feather Gods, but those who have reached the Hao God level are much, much less. As for the Mysterious God level, there seem to be even fewer, but they are not none.
Chunlan City has a total of three sub-cities, which are almost adjacent to Chunlan City. At first glance, they appear to be connected into one.of.
In the second sub-city, the atmosphere immediately became much quieter, but there was still a lot of traffic.
Under the leadership of Ran Shaoyan, they quickly arrived at a relatively hidden corner.
